summary: Completed testing of Iteration 288 - Marketing Videos (Sora 2 Integration). Backend: 31/31 tests passed (100%). Frontend: MarketingVideosPanel loads correctly with Turkish UI, all form elements functional, video generation queues successfully with toast notification.
seed_data_creation: Created test video jobs during backend tests, created test public event 'TEST_Yaz Şefler Akşamı 2026' for from-event testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 288 fully tested. Sora 2 marketing video generation integration working. Key endpoints: GET /api/marketing-videos/sizes (4 sizes, 3 durations, 2 models), POST /api/marketing-videos/generate (creates queued job), GET /api/marketing-videos (list with filtering), GET /api/marketing-videos/{job_id}, POST /api/marketing-videos/from-event/{event_id} (auto-prompt from event metadata). Frontend panel at 'AI Pazarlama Videoları (Sora 2)' in SYSTEM section. Jobs show status badges (Kuyrukta/Üretiliyor/Tamamlandı/Hata). Note: Sora 2 content moderation may reject simple prompts with 'Sora 2 returned empty video' - use detailed cinematic prompts.

endpoints: GET /api/marketing-videos/sizes - returns 4 sizes, 3 durations (4/8/12), 2 models (sora-2, sora-2-pro), defaults (1024x1792, 8s, sora-2)
POST /api/marketing-videos/generate - creates job with status='queued', starts background task
GET /api/marketing-videos - lists jobs with filtering by status and source_type
POST /api/marketing-videos/from-event/{event_id} - auto-generates cinematic prompt from event metadata
from_event_tests: Creates job with source_type='public_event' and source_id=event_id
Auto-generates rich cinematic prompt from event title, description, tags, property name/city

panel_elements: Turkish UI: 'Pazarlama Videosu Üretici', 'SORA 2 · SOCIAL MARKETING'
Left sidebar: 'Yeni Video' form with prompt textarea, size/duration/model dropdowns, 'Üret' button
Right side: 'Üretim Geçmişi' job history list with StatusBadge per job
Status badges: Kuyrukta (queued), Üretiliyor (rendering), Tamamlandı (completed), Hata (failed)
Completed jobs show inline video player + download link
interactions_tested: Generate button disabled without prompt, enabled with prompt
Generate button click queues job and shows success toast
Toast message: 'Video kuyruğa alındı — 2-5 dk içinde hazır olacak'

public_events_panel.video_button: FilmReel icon button with data-testid='event-video-{id}' calls /from-event endpoint (verified via backend tests)

notes: Sora 2 integration is REAL (not mocked) via emergentintegrations.llm.openai.video_generation.OpenAIVideoGeneration. Video generation takes 2-5 minutes. Jobs transition: queued → rendering → completed/failed. Failed jobs with 'Sora 2 returned empty video' are due to Sora content moderation rejecting prompts - use more descriptive cinematic prompts.
